scope.evidence_kind: Robolectric NATIVE rendering, not installed-device capture

junit_inspection.method: Read archived XML; not independently re-executed

observations: All 16 metadata messages match their exact local resource wrapper plus M03 reason.
Both Ainu scripts and vi-Hani show the entire status at normal and double scale without apparent missing-glyph boxes or status clipping.

Manchu normal-scale status is wholly visible. Double-scale visible trailing columns show no apparent tofu or vertical ink clipping; earlier columns are offscreen at the captured terminal rail position.
U+8FD4 is visibly present in both vi-Hani action statuses at both scales. All four vi-Hani capture hashes equal the initial-head captures, now independently carried in the successor archive.
limitations: All reviewed captures are Robolectric NATIVE host rendering at API 35, 320 x 640 dp, xhdpi. They are not installed-device screenshots.
Sixteen selected images were visually inspected. The other 32 M03 images were integrity/metadata checked, not visually reviewed in this successor review.

M03 asserts full source/accessibility text, no ellipsizing, measured layout coverage, and status visibility. For horizontal scripts it checks the complete visible status bounds. For vertical scripts it programmatically checks both rail ends and full-height visibility.

The vertical branch scrolls to 0 and end, calls resetToReadingStart(), then immediately draws without another explicit layout. The reset implementation requests layout. The Manchu 2x stills show the terminal tested position, not a fresh first-reading-position capture; this is a capture limitation, not an established application scrolling defect.

Visible scrollbars and source structure do not alone prove touch gesture behavior. This M03 review does not claim real-device M03 scrolling or per-pixel review of offscreen two-times-scale Manchu columns.

No competent-language, native-speaker, or typographic/shaping certification is claimed. Source/metadata equality and visible glyphs do not establish correct translation or every script-specific joining choice.

The previously disclosed Pillow/FreeType source-versus-subset U+8FD4 mismatch at 24 px is retained. Matching 48/96 px masks and preserved outlines/metrics do not imply all-size raster identity. No cause is inferred, and that non-equivalence is not itself classified as an application bug.
Bundled-font loading and hash verification in installed API 35 instrumentation is separate evidence. Its success would not directly exercise the M03 status text; it is not claimed here.
No source was edited, no heavy tests were run, and no remote write or merge/readiness decision was made during this review.
